read_me: This is a source-separated research snapshot, not a verified live ordering catalog.
The Zomato indexed category counts total 181 rows; all 181 names were recovered. Live prices, add-ons, stock, item photos and complete descriptions were not available.
District contains 94 printed rows across one beverage page and three food pages. All four pages were transcribed, including visible prices and variants.
Food/Beverages grouping is preserved separately within each source. Falooda is assigned to Food as a dessert. Zomato category anomalies remain where published and carry flags.
Never copy a District dine-in price into a Zomato delivery item merely because the names resemble one another.
Null means unknown or not retrieved, never zero, unavailable, allergen-free, or not applicable.
Source wording/spelling is preserved in names. Ingredient arrays are factual normalized transcriptions, not complete recipes or allergen declarations.
Menu photographs do not provide item-specific photo mappings; image URL fields remain null.
No items were deduplicated across sources; the two menus overlap and 275 rows does not mean 275 unique dishes.
No current website publishing or ordering use should occur until the cafe confirms its master menu.
